verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an AI-oriented CLI entry point (`npx @sentry/ai install`) that configures Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok to use Sentry, alongside its general-purpose `sentry-cli` for release/source-map management — but these are two separate, narrow tools rather than one unified AI-native CLI, and neither has independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent verification of the @sentry/ai CLI's functionality, evidence of broader AI-native CLI capabilities beyond installer setup, and unification with the general sentry-cli.
